retrieval.github_artifacts: Authenticate to GitHub; GET the artifact ZIP API URLs by recorded ID and verify SHA256. Historical bytes are not R5 acceptance.
retrieval.cross_machine_limit: Git alone cannot recreate local raw logs. Obtain the archive from the evidence custodian and verify its digest; do not claim an unavailable blob was re-fetched.

r5_result_identity: Final R5 source must be the containing delivery commit, not the input R4 SHA. Post-commit exact-SHA execution receipts belong to PR #1 without rewriting the tested tree.

r5_precommit_evidence.retrieval: Evidence custodian supplies exact archive; verify SHA256, then extract under a new ignored directory. Not in Git; cloning alone cannot retrieve local logs.
r5_precommit_evidence.invalid_harness_rule: Uncorrected contract-*.xml used input checkout after host Git -C failed; *-unmarked.json refused missing physical marker. Use *-corrected.xml and *-marked.json only as source replay evidence.

r5_historical_guard_modules.retrieval: Same controlled-local custodian procedure; original seven source-guard modules, no filter.
